faq.subheadline: Everything you need to know about City Gate Capital. Can't find an answer?

items.a: The pre-deployment includes account-security controls such as multi-factor authentication and secure sessions. It does not hold customer funds or crypto assets, and no custody service is active.

items.q: What happens if I lose access to my account?
items.a: The pre-deployment supports password-reset and account-security workflows. Support response times and identity re-verification service levels are not guaranteed.

items.q: How quickly can I open an account?
items.a: You can create a pre-deployment profile to explore the interface. Live identity verification, funding, and transactions are not enabled.

items.q: What currencies and crypto do you support?
items.a: The pre-deployment displays selected fiat currencies and digital assets using sample or market data. Live availability will depend on approved providers and launch jurisdictions.
Displayed plans and prices are illustrative concepts. No paid banking subscription, transfer allowance, card, or investment service is currently offered.

items.q: Are there hidden fees on transfers?
items.a: The pre-deployment uses illustrative fees and rates. Final pricing, spreads, and disclosures will be published only after provider and legal approval.
The interface demonstrates amount, recipient, rate, fee, and status screens. It does not transmit or settle funds.

items.q: Can I schedule or automate recurring transfers?
items.a: Recurring transfers and target-rate actions are demonstration features. The pre-deployment does not execute live payments or currency conversions.
